story.label: Opening
story.value: Water falls somewhere beyond the lamplight. The stone passage carries a cold draught from the deeper galleries.

story.label: The request
story.value: Barvin brings the work to the party through Deep Delver Guild. Barvin secretly gathers information for a faction or local ruler.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: First expedition
story.value: Begin at Wreck of the Quiet Trade Road. Break the overgrown lock array on the family holding, answering only to a spoken roster of names. Collect three sealed jars of witch-iron, from the salvaged reagent cells. Overcome the Elephant holding the disputed threshold of the abandoned store. Each section has its own holder and marked threshold. The other listed sites are additional jobs in the same region.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: Stakes
story.value: The local faction wants the work completed before rivals can claim its outcome. Failure leaves the claim unsettled; success gives the party a result they can bring back and defend.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: At the table
story.value: The associated encounters use the listed reaction rolls. Treasure is allocated to the listed sites, but its discovery and access still need to be resolved in play. Tarot meanings are prompts; they do not add an unlisted power or compel an outcome.
story.source: Published dossier assembly and play policy

faction.agenda: Map subterranean corridors, secure profitable silver lodes, and maintain rescue routes to the surface.

reading.title: CONSTRUCT
reading.description: A modron wields a wrench in the interior of a vast clockwork machine. This card signifies things made by hand, including Constructs.
reading.meaning: An object fashioned with minimum alteration of its raw materials, or a magic item useful against Constructs (such as a Mace of Smiting).

reading.title: ELEMENTAL
reading.description: A jungle xorn feeds in an Underdark cavern. This card suggests an elemental creature or reducing a thing to its essence.
reading.meaning: Forces from the Elemental Planes spilling into the world.

reading.title: CAVERN
reading.description: A vast cavern is adorned with glowing fungi and striking stone formations. The Cavern card suggests exploration and delving into hidden secrets.
reading.meaning: A situation that requires delving into hidden motivations and secrets.

faction.name: Librarians of Leng
faction.asset: Sunless archives, eldritch scrolls, and brain-stealing wardens
faction.agenda: Guard occult manuscripts from surface barbarians and preserve cosmic secrets in darkness.

npc.quirk: Boasts of monster kills; wears a predator fang necklace.
npc.interaction: Looking to join an expedition as a retainer (Daily Wage).

reading.title: TALONS
reading.description: A clawed hand reaches to grab an emerald ring, which disintegrates at the claw's approach. The Talons card indicates greed or the rapacious hunger of a predator.
reading.meaning: A tenement or workhouse where oppressed victims of the rich live in squalor.
